title: The Edge of Chaos: Mapping the Phase Space of Emergent Life in a Stochastic Artificial Chemistry

contributions.purpose: 构建可系统扫描 abiogenesis 参数空间的人工生命模型
contributions.mechanism: 50x50 环形 2D 网格随机人工化学(单体 A/B 组装自复制聚合物,含 growth/mutation/fragmentation/degradation/seeding,严格物质守恒),配 PhaseSpaceMapper agent 做参数网格搜索
contributions.evaluation: 对每个参数点跑多 trial 分类终态(灭绝/低稳定/不稳定增长/高稳定复杂)
contributions.domain: 人工生命 / 复杂性起源 / 天体生物学
contributions.source_quote: we introduce a novel agent-based model of a stochastic artificial chemistry to systematically investigate the "phase space" of abiogenesis.

contributions.purpose: 验证复杂生命涌现是相变而非渐变
contributions.mechanism: 实验1 扫 mutation_prob × fragmentation_prob(20x20 网格,每点 5 trial,共 2000 次仿真,各 3000 步)绘相图
contributions.evaluation: 存在'混沌边缘'尖锐相变:高稳定复杂只在低 fragmentation 的窄带出现,夹在 Sea of Stasis(低突变)与 Desert of Extinction(高碎裂)之间
contributions.source_quote: the transition to a state capable of supporting high complexity is not gradual, but rather a sharp phase transition that occurs at the "edge of chaos".

contributions.purpose: 厘清移动性对复杂性的作用
contributions.mechanism: 实验2 消融:扫 diffusion_prob × slither_prob(15x15 网格,5 trial),固定其他参数
contributions.evaluation: 移动性是必要非充分条件:能防灭绝但全参数空间 High Stable Complexity 概率≈0,系统只停在低稳定复杂
contributions.source_quote: mobility is a necessary but not sufficient condition for the evolution of complex life.

self_declared_provenance.quote: While previous A-Life research has largely focused on demonstrating that life-like behaviors can emerge, our project's primary contribution is the use of a computational agent (the PhaseSpaceMapper) to systematically map the entire landscape of possible outcomes.

notes: 该文 withdrawn。C3 为明确的必要非充分负结果(移动性)。数据红旗:图1 左相图的'稳定复杂岛'紧贴最左列(fragmentation_prob≈0.0025),几乎全图其余为 0,相边界落在参数扫描范围的边缘而非内部,说明扫描区间可能未覆盖真正的相变带;图2 左相图整片均一(High Stable Complexity 全 0)。作者限制部分诚实(简化化学、静态环境、无显式自然选择、有限仿真步长 3000 可能不足)。玩具模型直接外推到 Fermi Paradox/天体生物学,推断跨度大。无编号贡献列表,由 abstract+conclusion 归纳。
